what_happened: Discovered during research: roughly a dozen extension implementation agents (lean, rust, typst, books, web, python, z3, nix, nvim, latex, and likely cslib/founder/epi) call git-commit-scoped.sh DIRECTLY for their per-phase commits (with --task {N} already passed for the V5 overlap check), and their own prose still instructs 'run the Phase-Commit Containment Self-Check (see general-implementation-agent.md's #### Phase-Commit Containment Self-Check)'. That section has since been mechanized ONLY inside git-commit-phase.sh, which none of these agents call -- so the cross-reference now points at dead prose and these ~12 agents' phase commits have NO Containment protection today, confirming the still-open gap this task's evidence file (specs/archive/336.../evidence/03_followup-mechanical-check.md) predicted.
